scope: Held-out batch-summary nonlinear shear-ramp test. Not SAOS Gprime/Gdoubleprime, raw replicate validation, measured-graph simulation or specimen-matched spatial calibration.
limitations: Published curves are means, not independent raw specimen histories.
SEM columnsF/I mislabeled0.6mg in source; treated as concentration grouping only and not used as precision weights.
Fixed buckling prior d0=.0025; no fitted failure/viscosity or Gdoubleprime law.
No test-batch modulus rescaling or refitting.
BatchC may differ materially in stiffness; poor transfer is a valid outcome.
